text: Many models now use default access with prerequisites. AccessDenied can reflect IAM, SCP, endpoint, Region, subscription, or account restrictions. Do not assume missing console activation.
Temperature zero does not guarantee universal deterministic output or factual accuracy. Evaluate the complete model configuration.
Converse standardizes a supported interface. Tool use, structured output, streaming, and other features remain model-specific. Validate business meaning after schema validation.
CloudTrail audit coverage and model invocation body logs are separate. Configure required event and invocation logging. Protect sensitive content and retention.
Always choose managed, always use RAG, and similar rules are source heuristics. Select the option that meets every explicit requirement.
Cache TTL, token thresholds, pricing, and supported APIs vary by model. Example prices are illustrative unless a current source establishes otherwise.
Check every eligible destination and required permission. A cross-Region profile does not preserve single-Region residency by default.
Guardrails do not replace data authorization, safe SQL execution, or tool validation. Automated Reasoning findings require application action and only cover the modeled policy.
These are repository practice questions, not verified AWS exam items. The mock reuses bank questions. Its raw percentage does not predict the AWS scaled score.
